title: The Maraketh
wikitext:
'''The Maraketh''' are a race/faction of [[Wraeclast]]. Their leaders are known as Sekhema. Their official language is "Marak". A large tribe is known to live in [[Highgate]]. All [[Maraketh weapons]] are related to this faction. ==Notable members== * Sekhema [[Asenath]] * Sekhema [[Deshret]] * Sekhema [[Oyun]] * Sekhema [[Orbala]], who became [[Garukhan, Queen of the Winds]] (according to ''POE 2'' lore) * Sekhema [[Solerai]] * Sekhema [[Lundara]] * [[Varashta, the Winter Sekhema]] * [[Aukuna, the Black Sekhema]] * [[Kira]] (later an enemy - [[Kira, Servant of Garukhan]]) * [[Tasuni]] * [[Irasha]] * [[Adiyah, the Wayfinder]] * [[Nashta, The Usurper]] * [[Balbala]] * [[Nasima]] * [[Nenet, the Scout]] (former) * [[Order of the Djinn#Historical members|Sumei]] (former) ===PoE 2=== * The [[poe2wiki:Sorceress|Sorceress]] * Sekhema [[poe2wiki:Asala|Asala]] * [[poe2wiki:Zarka|Zarka]] ===Solerai and Lundara=== The Heist quest {{il|Contract: A Matter of Honour}} and targets {{il|Seal of Lunaris}} & {{il|Seal of Solaris|Solaris}} suggest that the legendary Sekhemas Lundara and Solerai may have in fact been [[Lunaris]] and [[Solaris]], goddesses of the Azmeri and the Eternal Empire. ===Deshret=== {{main|Deshret}} [[Deshret]] is a legendary Sekhema of the Maraketh that sealed the entrance to [[The Mines Level 1|The Mines]] as well as ordered her villagers to guard the door at the [[Highgate]]. ==Lore== ===The Faridun=== {{see also|Faridun}} The Faridun is a faction exiled by the Maraketh to [[the Vastiri Desert]] for being "unworthy or flawed"{{efn|... the Faridun. They are our rejects. Those we Maraketh left to die in the desert as children for being unworthy or flawed." - [[Adiyah]], "Nenet"}} The [[rogue]] [[Nenet]] comes from this faction. The Faridun are featured in the Act 2 of the ''[[Path of Exile 2]]'' as an enemy faction. The quest {{ql|The Immortal Syndicate}} refers the Vastiri Desert as the "Maraketh Desert". ===The Afarud=== The Afarud are a group of Faridun outcasts. The "outcast of outcasts", the Afarud employ forbidden acts and dark rituals even the Faridun would not. Having nowhere to call home, the Afarud seek the destruction of Maraketh and Farudun alike, along with themselves. Their leader, [[Saresh]], leads the Afarud from the shadows. ===Order of the Djinn=== {{see also|Order of the Djinn}} Apparently, Maraketh has some relation with the [[Order of the Djinn]]. The Order has a vault in Vastiri (in [[The Oasis]] in in-game area), while the Highgate is next to [[the Vastiri Desert]] and The Oasis in terms of in-game areas. [[Jun, Veiled Master]] uses some in-game fictional language that is also used by members of Maraketh, such as ''akhara''. She also introduced herself as "of Vastiri". The order also fostered people that were exiled by the Marakethaccording to the flavour text of [[Order of the Djinn#Scarabs|Rusted Reliquary Scarab]]. (as well as other races). ==History== {{see also|History of Wraeclast#The Maraketh (3rd Galvano of Vitali 1333 IC)}} [[Bow]]s are a common weapon for the Maraketh. Their unique weapon designs lead to some of their archers are more effective at close range than from afar.
As a soldier you want to get close to enemy archers. That is not the case when fighting the Maraketh.{{efn|{{il|Chin Sol}}}}
===The Winter of the World=== The Winter of the World is the first event in recorded Maraketh history. The war spans the years between the rise of the [[Lightless]] to their defeat at the hands of [[Solerai]] and [[Lundara]]. After the Lightless's initial attack on the [[primeval civilization]], [[The Clayshaper]], along with the Maraketh's "scant survivors" of the Lightless's initial attack, formed an alliance to found the [[Order of the Djinn]] See [[Order of the Djinn#Scarabs|Rusted Abyss Scarab]] and repel the Lightless's invasions on [[the Vastiri Plains]]. Using her [[golems]] and the "relics of power" See [[Order of the Djinn#Scarabs|Polished Abyss Scarab]], Ahkeli helped the Maraketh triumph. All life on the Vastiri - the humans, serpents, hyenas, and golems - united together to fight back against the Lightless, forming an alliance known as the Third Pact.[[poe2wiki:Against the Darkness]] During a period of hopelessness, twin sister Sekhemas [[Solerai]] and [[Lundara]] arose, Solarai wielding a {{il|Solerai's Spear|spear}} with the "essence of gold" and Lundara with a weapon with the "essence of silver". The Winter of the World was ended by [[the Three Sisters]] resulting in Kulemak's defeat and the Lightless being driven back underground and the survival of the Maraketh and the [[Order of the Djinn]]. See [[Order of the Djinn#Scarabs|Gilded Abyss Scarab]] The Three Sisters also created [[the Viridian Wildwood]] to provide a refuge for the [[Azmeri]] people during the Winter of the WorldThe Warden of Eaves, "The Wildwood" and the dangers of [[Wraeclast]] after a volcanic eruptionThe Primal Huntress, "The Sun", as well as diverting [[Beyond|the Scourge]] away from WraeclastThe Breaker of Oaths, "The Scourge". Details about this event and the rise of the Three Sisters are of interest to many Wraeclast scholars, such as [[the Crimson Scribe]]. See [[Seal of Solaris]] and [[Seal of Lunaris]] ==Culture== Tempered by the harsh environment they live in, the Maraketh hold a strict traditionalist culture. All Maraketh are expected to pull their weight in contributing to the wellbeing of their akhara (tribe), with severe punishments enacted for dishonoring them. The Maraketh of the Vastiri Desert live in roaming caravans pulled by beasts of burden and prisoners of war. Women play a larger part in their society compared to other cultures. The Maraketh primarily pass down their history orally through tale-women. The Maraketh worship [[Garukhan, Queen of the Winds]], which in ''[[Path of Exile 2]]'' it was revealed that she is a former Sekhema and reach godhood. Maraketh also worships Solerai and Lundara as legendary Sekhemas. The most important commandment in Maraketh tradition is "Honour the Mother, Honour the Life".{{efn|"The most important commandment in our people's tradition is this: Honour the Mother, Honour the Life." - [[Irasha]], "Maraketh Tradition"}}
"When the hyena howls thrice death is sure to follow." -Maraketh Wisdom{{efn|{{il|Al Dhih}}}}
===Djinns=== One special method the Maraketh use to punish their criminals and traitors are by turning them into Djinns. Djinns are people who have had their souls bound to an inanimate object, traditionally a coin called a barya, allowing them to persist for centuries as spirits. Djinns earn the right to be released from their sentence by serving the living. The first Djinns were created by [[Varashta]], employing techniques similar to what the Karui ''hatungo'' use. Her daughter, Rashi, became the first djinn and formed the ''sel khari''.
